Sedjem 0.3.1 counts more of how it is used, still anonymously, and no longer loses the counts that waited while the
computer was offline.

## Download

- Windows 10 and 11: `Sedjem-0.3.1-setup.exe` installs for your user, without admin rights. It isn't
  signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
  Installing over 0.3.0 keeps your transcriptions, keys and models.
- Linux (x64): unpack `Sedjem-0.3.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `Sedjem/Sedjem`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums of both.

0.3.0 can update itself: *Settings → Updates*, then *Update now*.

## Anonymous usage counts

- The same three events as in 0.3.0, about six a month for an install used every week, with more in them. Every
  value is still a whole number or one of a few fixed words, and none of them names you, your recordings or your
  transcripts.
- Once a month: how long ago the install was first counted, some settings (the update channel and check, the
  default language, the speaker model, whether the graphics card is used, whether assistants may save), the
  computer in broad ranges (the makers of the processor and the graphics card, the graphics memory, CUDA and
  Vulkan, the power profile, the free disk space), the size of the library in ranges, which models and speaker
  models are downloaded, and which hosted services have a key (whether there is one, never the key).
- Once for each week of use: on how many days Sedjem was used and how often it was started; the runs by hosted
  service, speaker model, length, language and device, with their minutes of audio and of processing; the failures
  by where they stopped, and the cancels; the YouTube captions taken and the courses added; the versions saved by
  editing, the renames, merges, branches, restores and combines; the copies, model downloads and uses of *Update
  now*; and how many requests assistants made and how many versions they saved, never what they asked.
- The events say which month or week they count and get their time when they are sent, so counts that waited
  while the computer was offline are no longer lost after a day.
- The switch is still in *Settings → About*, and `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` or `SEDJEM_NO_USAGE=1` still turns the counts
  off. Everything that is sent is listed in
  [usage counts](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/blob/main/docs/13-usage-counts.md).

## Known limits

- The installer is unsigned, and macOS isn't built.
- On Linux, *Update now* unpacks the new build next to the old one rather than replacing it.
- Nemotron-3-Diarization hears at most 8 speakers.
